say:2:1211133001:0.text: We finally did it! We made it back to Rustport in one piece!
say:2:1211133001:0.source_cn: 成功了，成功了！我们平安返回锈锚港了！

say:3:1211133002:0.text: Cheers to Captain Sinbad! Thanks to you, we set sail just in time!
say:3:1211133002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达船长万岁！多亏你及时开船！

say:4:1211133003:0.text: It's all thanks to this compass...

say:6:1211133005:0.text: Really? Just for a moment there, I felt like I heard my old man's voice.
say:6:1211133005:0.source_cn: 我也不知道，就刚才那一瞬间，我好像听见了老爹的叮嘱。
say:6:1211133005:0.male: Really? Just for a moment there, I felt like I heard my old man's voice.
say:6:1211133005:0.female: Really? Just for a moment there, I felt like I heard my old man's voice.

say:7:1211133007:0.text: You're already a real captain! From now on, the compass will guide you wherever you want to go!
say:7:1211133007:0.source_cn: 你已经是个真正的船长了！今后，无论你要去哪，都有罗盘为...

say:8:1211133008:0.text: *Nervous laughter* We've only got one problem now—Hodgkin took Nara.
say:8:1211133008:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈……唯一可惜的是，奈拉被霍德希金带走了。

say:11:1211133009:0.text: I have to bring her back!
say:11:1211133009:0.source_cn: 我一定要把奈拉带回来！

say:12:1211133010:0.text: Calm down, Sonja. I understand how you feel, but you saw what Hodgkin's little trinket did to Nara. We need to come up with a plan.
say:12:1211133010:0.source_cn: 你冷静点，我理解你的心情。但是霍德希金的那个宝贝你们也...

say:13:1211133011:0.text: What's the deal with that thing anyway?

say:14:1211133012:0.text: Water Wights, here's your chance to get back at Hodgkin! You've been wronged, and now is the perfect time for revenge!
say:14:1211133012:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮的兄弟，是你们戴罪立功的时候了，霍德希金都这么对...

say:18:1211133014:0.text: That thing of Hodgkin's can turn the living into Graveborns! The Dead Tide Fleet calls it the "Void Relic."
say:18:1211133014:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队把那东西称作<style=highlight>...

say:19:1211133015:0.text: Where did he get it from?
say:19:1211133015:0.source_cn: 这么厉害？他从哪弄来的？

say:20:1211133016:0.text: I have no idea. Nara's been trying to get her hands on it for ages, but even she doesn't know much about it. It seems like only Hodgkin's most trusted advisors, like Viperian, get to see it up close.
say:20:1211133016:0.source_cn: 不知道，奈拉大姐头一直想搞来玩玩，但就连她也不知道。好...

say:23:1211133017:0.text: Well, if that's the case, attacking them head-on isn't the smartest option. We need to come up with a clever plan.
say:23:1211133017:0.source_cn: 既然如此，从正面进攻对我们来说不明智，还是要智取。

say:24:1211133018:0.text: Don't get any ideas about stealing it! That thing can recognize its owner! Those who tried to steal it before didn't end well.
say:24:1211133018:0.source_cn: 你们也别想着偷它！那东西认主，曾经有人去偷，下场很惨。

say:25:1211133019:0.text: Alright, thanks for letting us know. Consider this your chance to make up for your past mistakes.
say:25:1211133019:0.source_cn: 行，知道了，算你戴罪立功。

say:28:1211133020:0.text: Sonja, what should we do next?

say:29:1211133021:0.text: The Dead Tide Fleet could strike at any time. We need to find Hugin and get the Chainkeeper ready with some cannons.
say:29:1211133021:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队随时可能攻过来，先去找呼金，把枷锁号也装上大炮。

choice:5:0:1.text: You were the one using the compass.
choice:5:0:1.male: You were the one using the compass.
choice:5:0:1.female: You were the one using the compass.

say:31:1211133004:0.male: I don't really know what happened, but for a moment, I felt like a real captain...

say:32:1211133006:0.text: And when I do become one, I'll navigate my own course...
say:32:1211133006:0.source_cn: 当我成为一个真正的船长，我就可以驶出自己的航路……
